name: Title
purpose: Open a deck or a chapter of one.

name: Section divider
purpose: Open a new part of the deck.

name: Statement
purpose: One argument, said plainly, with a photograph.

name: Highlights
purpose: Three or four figures that carry the page.

name: Icon cards
purpose: A set of capabilities, services or principles.

name: Comparison
purpose: Two or three options read side by side.

name: Org chart · reporting tree
purpose: Who reports to whom, three levels at most.

name: Org chart · flat team band
purpose: A team of peers, no hierarchy implied.

name: Org chart · group structure
purpose: A holding company and the businesses under it.

name: Process
purpose: Stages that run in order, start to finish.

name: Timeline
purpose: Dates in order, with what happened at each.

name: Infographic
purpose: One visual in the middle, the parts around it.

name: Image and specs
purpose: One project or product, pictured and specified.

name: Table
purpose: Rows and columns, where the detail has to be exact.

name: Full-bleed image
purpose: Let one photograph carry the page.

name: Closing
purpose: End the deck: the ask, and how to reach you.
